punch.jab.startup.desc: Jab: Startup frames before the fist extends.

punch.jab.sourEarly.desc: Jab: Early sour frames while the fist extends.

punch.jab.sweet.desc: Jab: Sweet frames at full extension.

punch.jab.recovery.desc: Jab: Recovery frames after the punch.

punch.jab.whiffRecovery.desc: Jab: Extra recovery frames after a miss.

punch.jab.sourBelow.desc: Jab: Enemy closer than this (lane units) is too close: sour.

punch.jab.headMax.desc: Jab: Sweet head hit up to this distance (lane units).

punch.jab.bodyMax.desc: Jab: Sweet body hit up to this distance (lane units).

punch.cross.startup.desc: Cross: Startup frames before the fist extends.

punch.cross.sourEarly.desc: Cross: Early sour frames while the fist extends.

punch.cross.sweet.desc: Cross: Sweet frames at full extension.

punch.cross.recovery.desc: Cross: Recovery frames after the punch.

punch.cross.whiffRecovery.desc: Cross: Extra recovery frames after a miss.

punch.cross.sourBelow.desc: Cross: Enemy closer than this (lane units) is too close: sour.

punch.cross.headMax.desc: Cross: Sweet head hit up to this distance (lane units).

punch.cross.bodyMax.desc: Cross: Sweet body hit up to this distance (lane units).

run.firstSpawnSec.desc: Delay before the first enemy appears (seconds).

enemy.spawnDistance.desc: Spawn distance from the player (lane units, off the top of the screen).

enemy.walkSpeed.desc: Enemy walk speed (lane units per second).

enemy.attackDistance.desc: Distance at which an enemy stops and winds up its punch (lane units).

enemy.minGap.desc: Minimum gap between queued enemies (lane units).

enemy.windupFrames.desc: Enemy wind-up before the punch (60 Hz frames).

enemy.strikeFrames.desc: Frames from wind-up end until the enemy punch lands.

enemy.damage.desc: Damage an enemy punch deals to the player.

enemy.leaveFrames.desc: Frames an enemy takes to move off to the side after punching.

enemy.leaveSpeed.desc: Sideways speed after punching (screen px per second).

enemy.knockFrames.desc: Frames the knocked off animation lasts.

enemy.knockSpeed.desc: Speed of the knock off (screen px per second).

points.head.desc: Points for a sweet head hit.

points.body.desc: Points for a sweet body hit.

punch.bufferFrames.desc: Frames a press is remembered while a punch is busy.

view.endDelayMs.desc: Pause before the end screen appears (ms).
